create_T5GemmaModelConfig: create a T5GemmaModelConfig to configure model name, max input length, and decode length
build_T5GemmaModel: build a T5GemmaModel from a T5GemmaModelConfig to load a pretrained T5Gemma for conditional generation
test_T5GemmaConverter: test the T5GemmaConverter to convert string inputs and examples into batched tokenized tensors
run_T5GemmaModel_decode: run the T5GemmaModel decode method to generate sampled output strings from input tensors
review_T5GemmaModel_compute_losses: review the T5GemmaModel compute_losses_and_metrics method to compute per-example losses and mean loss metric
